caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass positioned in the center of a plain beige background. The glass is depicted with a greenish tint and subtle shading, which gives it the appearance of being made from slightly colored glass. It has a simple, cylindrical body that tapers inward toward the base, ending in a circular, textured foot. Small highlights and elliptical reflections are visible on the surface of the glass, suggesting its glossy and smooth texture. The composition is minimalist, with no other objects or background details present, focusing attention on the single glass. The artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Toddy Glass
